    USDT vs USDC: what the numbers show

    Tether's market cap of about $183.07B is 2.5 times USD Coin's ($74.04B); they rank #3 and #5 of the 114 coins tracked here. Both are US-dollar stablecoins. Over the past year Tether closed between $0.9976 and $1.000 per day (a 0.27% range) and USD Coin between $0.9994 and $1.002 (0.29%). Their largest falls between daily closes within the year were 0.3% and 0.2%.
